ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white (estimated 80-85%) against low-intensity black/dark-green border and internal markings (estimated 15-20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central field bounded by a solid dark band along the superior trailing edge and lateral tips. Distinct dark pigmentation cluster at the inferior center point (peduncle junction).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex; angle approximately 75-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude serrations along the entire superior boundary, with more jagged peaks observed on the right lobe's distal half.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the inferior edges sweeping upward toward sharp, tapered lateral tips; superior edges exhibit a complex concave-to-convex transition.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular/oval high-contrast outlines (rosettes) distributed across the white field; notable clusters in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe, including a primary diagonal mark extending from the mid-lobe toward the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark pigmentation smudge at the base of the median notch and distinct parallel rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pair of small dark circular spots located in the lower-left central region of the white field.
